ranked.headline: Graph and language-model architectures predict drug-target affinity and interactions
ranked.summary: Multiple December 2025 studies pair learned protein and drug representations with graph, Mamba, or attention models for binding prediction.

ranked.headline: Reference-based benchmarking now validates transcriptomic analysis tools across modalities
ranked.summary: Replicated long-read data, spatial batch effects, and imaging segmentation errors now demand explicit validation of analysis tools against defined reference…

ranked.headline: Pathology foundation models are coupled with omics, text, and spatial representations
ranked.summary: Preprints and published papers in December 2025 pair histology foundation models with genomic, text, and spatial omics inputs.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale models link bacterial gene content to metabolic function across strains
ranked.summary: Genome-scale metabolic models and Tn-seq now scale to thousands of genomes and multiple strains, connecting gene content to metabolic function.

ranked.headline: Learned models couple omics data and biomedical text for traceable hypothesis generation
ranked.summary: Retrieval-grounded LLM and graph systems now link omics and disease associations to literature evidence for hypothesis testing.

ranked.headline: Guidance and acquisition priors steer molecular generation toward design criteria
ranked.summary: Recent preprints embed property criteria directly into generative flow-matching and selection loops rather than filtering outputs afterward.

ranked.headline: Latent representations of brain activity learned across fMRI, iEEG, spikes, and LFP
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous neural recordings across spatial scales, modalities, and durations now motivate representation models that handle that variability directly.

ranked.headline: Lineage and spatial context quantify multicellular developmental modes
ranked.summary: Lineage tracking tools now feed parameterized geometric models that quantify developmental mode from single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Learned inverse models recover biological quantities from noisy or indirect measurements
ranked.summary: Learned reconstruction methods are now evaluated on held-out subjects, simulations, and unlabeled live-cell measurements.

ranked.headline: Multiscale models couple spatial microbial and cellular dynamics with population outcomes
ranked.summary: Reduced-order and multiscale PDE-ODE frameworks now link intracellular-scale kinetics to network, aggregate, and population-level behavior.

ranked.headline: Open tools for structure-informed analysis of molecular ensembles, complexes, and glycans
ranked.summary: Preprints and a December 2025 publication apply 3D structural data to evolutionary, interaction-fingerprint, complex-alignment, and glycan analysis.

ranked.headline: Single-cell models resolve cell states, sample trajectories and cell-cell communication
ranked.summary: Population-scale and sample-level single-cell embeddings now link disease and developmental trajectories to cell-state and communication readouts.

ranked.headline: Computational approaches to targets that resist conventional ordered-fold modeling
ranked.summary: Disordered, multistate, and membrane targets are being attacked with enhanced sampling, agentic design, and ML-augmented simulation.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics and graph models predict BRAF inhibitor response in cancer cell lines
ranked.summary: Attention-based multi-omics fusion and systematic encoding benchmarks are sharpening predictions of cancer drug and perturbation response.

ranked.headline: Learned and network models link gene perturbations to single-cell phenotypes
ranked.summary: Pooled imaging screens, network perturbation metrics, and in-vitro-to-in-vivo transport tests now quantify gene effects at single-cell resolution.

ranked.headline: Spatially resolved single-cell profiling links cell identity to tissue niches
ranked.summary: Spatial methylation, imaging mass cytometry, and isoform-aware atlases extend single-cell readouts into embryos, bladder, and colon tissue.

ranked.headline: Circuit-constrained network models link E/I structure to neural dynamics across scales
ranked.summary: Recent work formalizes circuit parameters as explicit constraints on neural dynamics, from single-network spectra to whole-brain fMRI measures.

ranked.headline: Caller choice and classifier design shape downstream mutation and variant interpretation
ranked.summary: Late-2025 benchmarks and tools test how calling, attribution and ACMG classification choices affect inference in tumour and germline data.

ranked.headline: Evolutionary history anchors large-scale inference of gene function and selection
ranked.summary: Growing genome collections now let phylogenetic and population-genetic structure serve as the basis for functional and evolutionary inference.

ranked.headline: MD of DND1 tandem RRMs shows inter-domain plasticity constraining RNA flexibility
ranked.summary: Residue-level simulations of tandem RRM-RNA binding and new RNA and quadruplex modeling tools now enable finer assessment of flexibility and folding.

ranked.headline: Open software for scalable genomic, chromatin, and metagenomic data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package regulatory-element features, interval operations, and QC pipelines for large sequencing datasets as reusable software.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale metabolic models guide growth media, strain design, and enzyme kinetics
ranked.summary: Recent items pair genome-scale metabolic models with optimization and machine learning for microbial medium, strain, and enzyme design.

ranked.headline: Long-read and T2T assemblies resolve variation in repeat-rich genomic architecture
ranked.summary: Complete and long-read assemblies now measure telomere, centromere, and rDNA variation directly rather than inferring it from short reads.

ranked.headline: Splicing variation and NMD efficiency read from sample-level RNA-seq metrics
ranked.summary: Sample-level RNA-seq metrics now link unproductive splicing and NMD efficiency in TCGA tumors to candidate RBP regulators.

ranked.headline: Computational methods extend peptide and proteoform identification from measured spectra
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers report reference-free de novo sequencing and imputation-aware proteoform discovery alongside deeper acquisition workflows.

ranked.headline: Comparative and environmental genomics resolve microbial and algal lineage boundaries
ranked.summary: Genome-scale sampling from isolates, metagenomes, and environmental plastids now resolves microbial and algal lineages and their gene content.

ranked.headline: Correcting platform and batch effects before pooled methylation and genotype inference
ranked.summary: Pooling data across array platforms introduces systematic biases in epigenetic age and genotype inference, addressed here by calibration and imputation.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models link treatment dynamics to metastatic spread and response
ranked.summary: Sparse clinical and lineage data are driving physics-informed and branching-process models of treatment response in cancer.

ranked.headline: Computational design of synthesizable, small-molecule and metal-binding binders
ranked.summary: Generative and learned-representation pipelines now target small-molecule, PROTAC, metal-binding, and protein-binder design with explicit binding objectives.

ranked.headline: Non-additive and regulatory genetic effects are being resolved beyond additive GWAS
ranked.summary: Recent studies move beyond additive single-trait models to resolve dominance, epistasis and causal regulatory structure in large cohorts.

ranked.headline: Auditing reference genome reliability across fungal, viral and nematode taxa
ranked.summary: Large public genome collections now require explicit audits of assembly quality, sampling provenance and taxonomic recognition before comparative use.

ranked.headline: Compartmental and vectorial models quantify transmission thresholds and spillover risk
ranked.summary: Recent work applies transmission models to STI prevention, arbovirus control, and pandemic potential assessment from experimental data.

ranked.headline: Genomic AMR prediction limited by threshold calibration and confounded training data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study expose calibration, rapid-detection and sampling limits on genomic resistance inference.

ranked.headline: ML on transcriptomic and multi-omic profiles predicts drug response and regulatory links
ranked.summary: Single-cell and TCGA profiles are now being mined by ML models for drug response, regulatory links and prognostic genes.

ranked.headline: Combinatorial path and block alignment formalized for pangenomes, genealogies, synteny
ranked.summary: Recent preprints formalize ordered-chain alignment to graph paths, genealogical trees, and synteny blocks with explicit combinatorial constraints.

ranked.headline: RNA-chromatin contacts and multi-epigenome profiling resolve 3D regulatory architecture
ranked.summary: Single-cell multi-epigenome integration and 4D Nucleome structural maps now link chromatin contacts, RNA association and transcriptional activation order.

ranked.headline: Biophysical models link axon geometry and stimulation fields to conduction output
ranked.summary: Explicit, reproducible multicompartment and field-coupled models now trace conduction and stimulation responses to specific structural and physical assumptions.

ranked.headline: Iterative deep learning and consensus models refine virtual screening hit identification
ranked.summary: Deep learning and consensus interaction models are improving virtual screening performance against SARS-CoV-2 helicase and PLK2 targets.

ranked.headline: Estimator-based methods recover structure from noisy single-cell and coexpression data
ranked.summary: Single-cell and network datasets are noisy and incompletely sampled, so inference reliability needs explicit uncertainty or topology-aware assessment.
